description: This Java source file defines a custom authentication filter for handling username and password authentication with JWT in a Spring Security context. It manages authentication attempts, handles locked account exceptions, and generates JWT tokens and refresh tokens, setting them in response headers and cookies.

classes.name: JwtUsernamePasswordAuthFilter
classes.description: A custom Spring Security filter for handling username/password authentication, generating JWT tokens, and managing lockout exceptions.

methods.name: JwtUsernamePasswordAuthFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with authentication manager, JWT configuration, and secret key.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate a user by reading credentials from the request input stream.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful authentication, generating tokens and setting response headers and cookies.

methods.name: handleLockedException
methods.description: Handles LockedException by returning a JSON error response with HTTP 403 status.
